settings.detail: The register of people told first when a chapter opens — and told again before it closes for good.
First sight of each chapter, its measurements before release, and the closing notice while pieces remain.
Nothing, and never a discount code. The price is the price. What you get is time.

settings.against_note: What this price band settles for
settings.heading: The weight — The Hoodie
settings.copy: Organic ring-spun cotton at 350 grams per square metre, cut oversized with a drop shoulder and a tear-away label so nothing sits against the neck. You feel the difference in the first minute of wearing it.

settings.heading: The mark — one placement
settings.copy: One crowned mark, sixty millimetres, measured from the hem and left alone. Never a second logo on the outside. Restraint is the strategy: the same mark, the same position, five times.

settings.heading: The edition — closed for good
settings.copy: Numbered, opened once, and retired when it closes. Graphics from a closed chapter are never reprinted, which is also why nothing in this house is ever discounted.
